test_title: PYST 39: SSC GD Constable 2024 - English (Held On: 01 Mar, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Improve the underlined part of the sentence. Choose 'No improvement' as an answer if the sentence is grammatically correct.

The __creek flooding__ every spring.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The original sentence** "The creek flooding every spring." **is missing a verb to properly convey the action.
 
• The correct form of the sentence should include a verb, making it** "The creek floods every spring."**
 
• Options 1 and 3 are grammatically incorrect as they either pluralize "creek" unnecessarily or use an incorrect verb tense.
 
• Option 4 ("No improvement") is also incorrect because the original sentence is grammatically flawed.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The creek** floods **every spring."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **1) creeks floods:** This option is incorrect because "creeks" is plural, which doesn't match the singular subject "The creek".
 
• **3) creek has been floods:** This option is grammatically incorrect because it uses an improper verb tense and structure.
 
• **4) No improvement:** This option is incorrect because the original sentence is missing a proper verb.
